title: India Mobile Congress 2026 launches 'Viksit Tech 47' platform to build Indian technology brands for global markets
description: India Mobile Congress 2026 has introduced Viksit Tech 47 to aid Indian technology firms in achieving global prominence. This platform aims to support companies in several technology sectors, including artificial intelligence and IoT. A flagship report assessing over 200 Indian tech companies will be released at the event. Viksit Tech 47 will also implement the Dr Zarabi Indigenisation Award for startups in hardware development.

title: ASCI releases guidelines for responsible labelling of AI-generated ad content
description: With brands increasingly using Artificial Intelligence to create or enhance ads, the Advertising Standards Council of India (ASCI) on Tuesday released guidelines to ensure responsible labelling of Synthetically Generated Content in Advertising. The self-regulatory industry body said that mandatory labelling or disclosure will be required where SCG content influences purchase decisions and when the absence of a disclosure could mislead consumers.
